# Native pnpm SDK supplemental terms

These original terms supplement the unchanged 132-package SDK lock. They enter
the separate private SDK bootstrap capsule with their exact byte hashes. Original
archives, manifests and package-provided notices remain retained in that capsule.
This directory does not grant new rights to the website or portal application and
does not establish complete identity-image license admission.

- `pnpm-components-LICENSE` applies to `@pnpm/util.lex-comparator@3.0.2`:
  [immutable original](https://github.com/pnpm/components/blob/5a7eefc9f6242e7c5f7d97348592ca87a796a880/LICENSE).
- `CC-BY-3.0.txt` supplements `spdx-exceptions@2.5.0`:
  [Creative Commons legal code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/legalcode.txt).
- `CC0-1.0.txt` supplements `spdx-license-ids@3.0.24`:
  [Creative Commons legal code](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode.txt).

The lex-comparator version and original source match that immutable components
commit. The two SPDX packages' original READMEs declare their respective Creative
Commons terms; the full standard texts are preserved here as supplements.
The adapter pins all three SHA-256 identities and checks them independently of
the capsule's own manifest.
